literature.headline_zh: 季节性流感病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 通过DEG分析鉴定出24个重叠DEG和13个中心基因。PPI、GO和KEGG富集分析显示这些基因主要在免疫和炎症通路中富集。scRNA-seq 分析表明,IAV 感染减少了 CD4+ 和 CD8+ T 细胞浸润,同时增加了巨噬细胞样单核细胞的丰度,并显着下调了 IL7R 的表达,尤其是 CD4+ T 细胞中的表达。 [10.1186/s12985-026-03272-5]
宿主 防御涉及分层的先天反应,该反应被蛋白质(例如非结构蛋白 1)拮抗,以及强大的适应性免疫,包括针对保守内部蛋白质的细胞毒性 CD8 + T 细胞和产生中和抗体的 B 细胞。 [10.1038/s41572-026-00727-5]
2025/26 季节的 A/H3N2 峰值增长率和随时间变化的繁殖数量的幅度相似,但比之前的严重季节发生得更早。 [10.1038/s44528-026-00016-3]
AS03佐剂的疫苗接种在24小时内上调先天免疫细胞中的免疫途径,包括吞噬作用、抗原呈递和加工、炎性体激活、NK细胞介导的细胞毒性、IgA产生和干扰素反应途径。 [10.3389/fimmu.2026.1786231]

在 16,739 例 SARI 病例中,13.5% 经实验室确诊为流感或 SARS-CoV-2。甲型H3N2流感病毒 在 2020 年占主导地位,随后 SARS-CoV-2 在 2021 年广泛传播。2022 年,SARS-CoV-2 与 甲型H3N2流感病毒 和乙型流感(维多利亚州)共同传播。2023 年,随着 SARS-CoV-2 和 甲型H3N2流感病毒 的下降,A(H1N1)pdm 成为主要毒株。2024年,甲型H3N2流感病毒再次引领流通,同时检测到B(维多利亚)和SARS-CoV-2。零星 A(H5N1) 病例于 2023 年底开始出现。 [10.1136/bmjopen-2025-114583]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。
literature.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following research developments.
key_findings_en: 24 overlapping DEGs and 13 hub genes were identified through DEG analysis. PPI, GO, and KEGG enrichment analyses revealed these genes were mainly enriched in immune and inflammatory pathways. [10.1186/s12985-026-03272-5]

Host defence involves a layered innate response, which is antagonized by proteins, such as non-structural protein 1, and a robust adaptive immunity comprising cytotoxic CD8 + T cells targeting conserved internal proteins and B cells producing neutralizing antibodies. [10.1038/s41572-026-00727-5]
Peak A/H3N2 growth rates and time-varying reproduction numbers for the 2025/26 season were of similar magnitude but occurred earlier than in previous severe seasons. [10.1038/s44528-026-00016-3]

AS03-adjuvanted vaccination upregulated immune pathways in innate immune cells within 24 hours, including phagocytosis, antigen presentation and processing, inflammasome activation, NK-cell mediated cytotoxicity, IgA production, and interferon-response pathways. [10.3389/fimmu.2026.1786231]

Among 16,739 SARI cases, 13.5% were laboratory-confirmed for influenza or SARS-CoV-2. A(H3N2) dominated in 2020, followed by widespread SARS-CoV-2 circulation in 2021. In 2022, SARS-CoV-2 co-circulated with A(H3N2) and influenza B (Victoria). [10.1136/bmjopen-2025-114583]

news.headline_zh: 季节性流感病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期季节性流感病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 本章提供了有关流感 监测 的一般指导,包括疾病背景、病例定义和 暴发 控制措施。它不报告具体事件,但概述了监测流感(N4、N6)的总体框架。 [news-43346f053a0e443f]
世卫组织全球呼吸道病毒活动每周更新第 589 号报告了 2026 年第 30 周的 季节性流感 和 SARS-CoV-2 监测。全球流感阳性率仍低于 10%,南半球温带和亚热带地区流感活动升高(>10%)。全球 SARS-CoV-2 阳性率保持稳定且较低,其中中美洲、加勒比海、热带南美洲以及南亚和东亚的单个国家的阳性率较高(>10%)。 [news-4867580ccf1439b6]
世卫组织表示,刚果埃博拉病毒 暴发 在宣布之前几个月就开始了。医疗保健领导人将在 NYSSPA 晚会上庆祝如何安全捕捉蝙蝠并避免狂犬病风险奥卡西奥-科尔特斯说,她在决定下一步政治行动时正在冷冻卵子据医生称,为什么过氧化氢对伤口和环孢子虫没有用。版权所有 2026 Nexstar Media,Inc. [news-86ba8efe70c54b91]
FDA 批准了 mFLUSIVA,这是第一个基于 mRNA 的 季节性流感 疫苗,适用于 50 岁及以上成年人,标志着下一代流感 疫苗 开发的里程碑。 [news-37b05943dc59edc1]
德里国家首都区报告了 暴发 猪流感疫情,记录了 1,300 多例 H1N1 病毒病例。文章还讨论了 疫苗接种 和卫生在预防流感症状传播方面的重要性。 [news-cd656993f8f6bec5]

papers.title: Influenza.
papers.abstract: Influenza A and B viruses are considerable public health threats. Annual seasonal epidemics are driven by antigenic drift and cause an estimated 3-5 million severe cases and 290,000-650,000 deaths annually. The clinical presentation of seasonal influenza is typically an abrupt, uncomplicated acute respiratory illness with full recovery; however, it can lead to severe, life-threatening complications in individuals at high risk. Antigenic shift caused by reassortment of a seasonal influenza A virus with avian and/or swine influenza A viruses has led to unpredictable pandemics. The successful cross-species transmission of influenza A viruses requires key viral adaptations, including changes in receptor specificity and compatibility with host factors such as ANP32A. Host defence involves a layered innate response, which is antagonized by proteins, such as non-structural protein 1, and a robust adaptive immunity comprising cytotoxic CD8 + T cells targeting conserved internal proteins and B cells producing neutralizing antibodies. Diagnosis primarily depends on highly sensitive PCR-based methods and multiplexed rapid antigen tests. Prevention involves annually updated seasonal vaccines (including inactivated, live attenuated and protein-based vaccines), while treatment relies on early use of neuraminidase and polymerase acidic protein inhibitors. Research priorities include the development of improved vaccines and a better understanding of influenza virus transmission from animals to humans.

papers.title: Deciphering influenza B virus-derived peptides and their presentation by HLA class I molecules.
papers.abstract: Despite influenza vaccines being widely available, influenza still causes significant morbidity and mortality annually. Vaccines typically induce humoral-mediated protection against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, necessitating that they be updated and administered each year. In contrast, CD8+ T cells, which can control and clear viral infections, can recognise more conserved viral epitopes. Therefore, there is considerable interest in understanding CD8+ T cell responses to influenza virus for the development of future vaccines and therapeutics. Although Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUAV) and Betainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUBV) co-circulate in humans and both contribute to seasonal epidemics, there is limited data regarding CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV. This knowledge gap spans both immunological and molecular insights. In the present review, we summarise the current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at both cellular and molecular levels, in comparison with FLUAV. Collectively, this highlights the limited data available on FLUBV, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.

papers.source_body_en: Despite influenza vaccines being widely available, influenza still causes significant morbidity and mortality annually. Vaccines typically induce humoral-mediated protection against rapidly mutating surface glycoproteins, necessitating that they be updated and administered each year. In contrast, CD8+ T cells, which can control and clear viral infections, can recognise more conserved viral epitopes. Therefore, there is considerable interest in understanding CD8+ T cell responses to influenza virus for the development of future vaccines and therapeutics. Although Alphainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUAV) and Betainfluenzavirus influenzae (FLUBV) co-circulate in humans and both contribute to seasonal epidemics, there is limited data regarding CD8+ T cell responses to FLUBV. This knowledge gap spans both immunological and molecular insights. In the present review, we summarise the current knowledge of FLUBV-derived CD8+ T cell epitopes at both cellular and molecular levels, in comparison with FLUAV. Collectively, this highlights the limited data available on FLUBV, despite its significant role in human influenza infections.

papers.title: Influenza A/H3N2 epidemiology in England during the 2025 to 2026 season: a mathematical modelling study.
papers.abstract: Abstract Background England experienced an unusually early and rapid increase in influenza A/H3N2 subclade K infections in 2025/26. Antigenic change and a fast selective sweep raised concerns over a potentially severe season. Building on analysis conducted as the subclade emerged, we aim to compare epidemic dynamics of the 2025/26 season to previous years and to model plausible epidemiological scenarios. Methods We compared peak epidemic growth rates and reproduction numbers across influenza seasons from 2011/12 to 2025/26 using routine surveillance data in England. Weekly epidemic growth rates were estimated using a Gaussian random walk model, and time-varying reproduction numbers using EpiEstim . We also developed an age-stratified transmission model and interactive web tool to explore scenarios varying immune escape, transmissibility, and seed date, using 2022/23 as a baseline season. Results Peak A/H3N2 growth rates and time-varying reproduction numbers for the 2025/26 season are of similar magnitude but earlier than previous severe seasons. Scenario analyses suggest early trends are compatible with moderate levels of immune escape, a 10% higher R 0 , or an earlier seed date, though it is not possible to distinguish the relative importance of these mechanisms from these data alone. Conclusions The 2025/26 influenza season is characterised by early but not unusually rapid growth. Earlier growth does not systematically lead to especially large epidemics due to earlier susceptible depletion combined with a dampening effect from school holidays. Laboratory evidence for antibody escape does not directly translate to large reductions in population immunity, supporting the need for complementary real-time epidemiological analyses and modelling.

papers.title_zh: 2025 年至 2026 年季节期间英格兰的 A/H3N2 流行病学 流感:数学模型研究。
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Background England experienced an unusually early and rapid increase in influenza A/H3N2 subclade K infections in 2025/26. Antigenic change and a fast selective sweep raised concerns over a potentially severe season. Building on analysis conducted as the subclade emerged, we aim to compare epidemic dynamics of the 2025/26 season to previous years and to model plausible epidemiological scenarios. Methods We compared peak epidemic growth rates and reproduction numbers across influenza seasons from 2011/12 to 2025/26 using routine surveillance data in England. Weekly epidemic growth rates were estimated using a Gaussian random walk model, and time-varying reproduction numbers using EpiEstim . We also developed an age-stratified transmission model and interactive web tool to explore scenarios varying immune escape, transmissibility, and seed date, using 2022/23 as a baseline season. Results Peak A/H3N2 growth rates and time-varying reproduction numbers for the 2025/26 season are of similar magnitude but earlier than previous severe seasons. Scenario analyses suggest early trends are compatible with moderate levels of immune escape, a 10% higher R 0 , or an earlier seed date, though it is not possible to distinguish the relative importance of these mechanisms from these data alone. Conclusions The 2025/26 influenza season is characterised by early but not unusually rapid growth. Earlier growth does not systematically lead to especially large epidemics due to earlier susceptible depletion combined with a dampening effect from school holidays. Laboratory evidence for antibody escape does not directly translate to large reductions in population immunity, supporting the need for complementary real-time epidemiological analyses and modelling.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景 2025/26 年,英格兰 A/H3N2 K 亚支感染异常早期且快速增加。抗原变化和快速选择性清扫引起了人们对可能出现严重季节的担忧。基于该分支出现时进行的分析,我们的目标是将 2025/26 季节的流行病动态与前几年进行比较,并模拟合理的流行病学情景。方法 我们使用英国常规 监测 数据比较了 2011/12 至 2025/26 流感季节的峰值流行增长率和繁殖数量。使用高斯随机游走模型估计每周流行病增长率,并使用 EpiEstim 估计随时间变化的繁殖数。我们还开发了一个按年龄分层的 传播 模型和交互式网络工具,以探索不同的免疫逃逸、传播性和播种日期的场景,使用 2022/23 作为基准季节。结果 2025/26 年季节的 A/H3N2 峰值增长率和随时间变化的繁殖数量的幅度相似,但早于之前的严重季节。情景分析表明,早期趋势与中等水平的免疫逃逸、R 0 高10%或较早的播种日期相一致,尽管不可能仅从这些数据中区分这些机制的相对重要性。结论 2025/26 流感季节的特点是增长较早,但增长速度并不异常迅速。由于较早的易感性消耗加上学校假期的抑制作用,较早的增长不会系统性地导致特别大规模的流行病。抗体逃逸的实验室证据并不直接转化为群体免疫力的大幅下降,这支持了补充实时流行病学分析和建模的必要性。

papers.title: An integrated bioinformatics analysis reveals that targeted activation of IL7R may reduce influenza A virus infection risk in patients with depression
papers.abstract: Depression has been associated with increased susceptibility to influenza; however, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis was performed to assess the causal relationship between depression and influenza. Differential expression genes (DEGs) analyses were performed using Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) datasets related to influenza A virus (IAV) infection and depression. Protein–protein interaction (PPI) analysis, Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis were employed to explore underlying mechanisms and identify hub genes involved in depression combined with IAV infection. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve validation and external datasets were conducted to validate the key gene. Immune infiltration and correlation analyses, together with single-cell RNA (scRNA) sequencing and virtual knockout (KO) simulation, were used to investigate altered immune cells and their associations with the key gene. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were performed to screen potential compounds targeting the key gene. Finally, in vitro experiments using IAV-infected Jurkat T cells further validated the roles of the key gene and candidate compound. MR analysis indicated that depression exerts a detrimental causal effect on influenza susceptibility. 24 overlapping DEGs and 13 hub genes were identified through DEG analysis. PPI, GO and KEGG enrichment analyses revealed these genes were mainly enriched in immune and inflammatory pathways. IL7R was identified as a key gene and was positively correlated with multiple T-cell subsets while negatively correlated with macrophages, as determined by ROC curve analysis, external validation datasets, and immune infiltration analysis. scRNA-seq analysis demonstrated that IAV infection reduced CD4 + and CD8 + T cells infiltration while increasing macrophage-like monocytes abundance and significantly downregulating IL7R expression, particularly in CD4 + T cells. Virtual KO of IL7R led to the upregulation of MT-CYB and MT-CO1 in CD4 + T cells. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations revealed that sanguinarine exhibited the strongest binding affinity for IL7R and maintained stable interaction. In vitro experiments further confirmed that sanguinarine reversed IAV-induced downregulation of IL7R and reduced viral replication. IL7R may serve as a potential therapeutic target, and sanguinarine represents a promising candidate for the treatment of depression combined with IAV infection through immune modulation.

papers.title_zh: 综合生物信息学分析表明,靶向激活 IL7R 可降低抑郁症患者感染甲型流感病毒的风险
papers.source_body_en: Depression has been associated with increased susceptibility to influenza; however, the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. Mendelian randomization (MR) analysis was performed to assess the causal relationship between depression and influenza. Differential expression genes (DEGs) analyses were performed using Gene Expression Omnibus (GEO) datasets related to influenza A virus (IAV) infection and depression. Protein–protein interaction (PPI) analysis, Gene Ontology (GO) and Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) enrichment analysis were employed to explore underlying mechanisms and identify hub genes involved in depression combined with IAV infection. Receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve validation and external datasets were conducted to validate the key gene. Immune infiltration and correlation analyses, together with single-cell RNA (scRNA) sequencing and virtual knockout (KO) simulation, were used to investigate altered immune cells and their associations with the key gene. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations were performed to screen potential compounds targeting the key gene. Finally, in vitro experiments using IAV-infected Jurkat T cells further validated the roles of the key gene and candidate compound. MR analysis indicated that depression exerts a detrimental causal effect on influenza susceptibility. 24 overlapping DEGs and 13 hub genes were identified through DEG analysis. PPI, GO and KEGG enrichment analyses revealed these genes were mainly enriched in immune and inflammatory pathways. IL7R was identified as a key gene and was positively correlated with multiple T-cell subsets while negatively correlated with macrophages, as determined by ROC curve analysis, external validation datasets, and immune infiltration analysis. scRNA-seq analysis demonstrated that IAV infection reduced CD4 + and CD8 + T cells infiltration while increasing macrophage-like monocytes abundance and significantly downregulating IL7R expression, particularly in CD4 + T cells. Virtual KO of IL7R led to the upregulation of MT-CYB and MT-CO1 in CD4 + T cells. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations revealed that sanguinarine exhibited the strongest binding affinity for IL7R and maintained stable interaction. In vitro experiments further confirmed that sanguinarine reversed IAV-induced downregulation of IL7R and reduced viral replication. IL7R may serve as a potential therapeutic target, and sanguinarine represents a promising candidate for the treatment of depression combined with IAV infection through immune modulation.

papers.title: Epidemiology, trends and determinants of influenza and SARS-CoV-2 positivity among severe acute respiratory infection patients in Cambodia, 2020-2024: a hospital-based retrospective cross-sectional surveillance data analysis.
papers.abstract: OBJECTIVE: To describe the epidemiological pattern, temporal trends of influenza and SARS-CoV-2, and determinants of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI)-confirmed positivity among patients hospitalised with SARI in Cambodia. DESIGN: A hospital-based retrospective cross-sectional surveillance data analysis using national sentinel SARI surveillance data collected from 2020 to 2024. SETTING: Nine SARI sentinel hospitals are located across Cambodia. PARTICIPANTS: A total of 16 739 hospitalised patients who met the SARI case definition. MEASURE: SARI-confirmed positivity defines all SARI cases with laboratory-confirmed influenza or SARS-CoV-2 infections as the main outcome measure. Descriptive and bivariate analyses were performed, followed by multivariate logistic regression to identify factors associated with SARI-confirmed positivity. RESULTS: Among 16 739 SARI cases, median age in years was 16 (IQR=59), with 54.6% being male; 13.5% were laboratory-confirmed for influenza or SARS-CoV-2. High mortality rate in 2021. A(H3N2) dominated in 2020, followed by widespread SARS-CoV-2 circulation in 2021. In 2022, SARS-CoV-2 co-circulated with A(H3N2) and influenza B (Victoria). A(H1N1)pdm became the predominant strain in 2023 as SARS-CoV-2 and A(H3N2) declined. In 2024, A(H3N2) again led circulation, with B(Victoria) and SARS-CoV-2 also detected. Sporadic A(H5N1) cases began appearing in late 2023. Multivariable analysis indicated higher odds of SARI-confirmed positivity among children aged 5-14 years (adjusted OR (aOR)=1.85; 95% CI 1.47 to 2.31) and adults 50-64 years (aOR=1.36; 95% CI 1.15 to 1.60) compared with adults 25-49 years, during the rainy season (aOR=2.09; 95% CI 1.89 to 2.32) and among patients in Phnom Penh compared with other regions (p<0.001). Influenza detection markedly increased from 2022 to 2024 following the decline observed during the COVID-19 pandemic. CONCLUSION: These results indicate that there was an increase in SARI trends over the periods and the changing influenza subtypes circulating each year, along with a high mortality rate during the Delta variant COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia. Age, region, year and season were significant factors associated with SARI-confirmed positivity. Targeted interventions and preventive measures should be prioritised for specific high-risk groups.

papers.abstract_original: OBJECTIVE: To describe the epidemiological pattern, temporal trends of influenza and SARS-CoV-2, and determinants of severe acute respiratory infection (SARI)-confirmed positivity among patients hospitalised with SARI in Cambodia. DESIGN: A hospital-based retrospective cross-sectional surveillance data analysis using national sentinel SARI surveillance data collected from 2020 to 2024. SETTING: Nine SARI sentinel hospitals are located across Cambodia. PARTICIPANTS: A total of 16 739 hospitalised patients who met the SARI case definition. MEASURE: SARI-confirmed positivity defines all SARI cases with laboratory-confirmed influenza or SARS-CoV-2 infections as the main outcome measure. Descriptive and bivariate analyses were performed, followed by multivariate logistic regression to identify factors associated with SARI-confirmed positivity. RESULTS: Among 16 739 SARI cases, median age in years was 16 (IQR=59), with 54.6% being male; 13.5% were laboratory-confirmed for influenza or SARS-CoV-2. High mortality rate in 2021. A(H3N2) dominated in 2020, followed by widespread SARS-CoV-2 circulation in 2021. In 2022, SARS-CoV-2 co-circulated with A(H3N2) and influenza B (Victoria). A(H1N1)pdm became the predominant strain in 2023 as SARS-CoV-2 and A(H3N2) declined. In 2024, A(H3N2) again led circulation, with B(Victoria) and SARS-CoV-2 also detected. Sporadic A(H5N1) cases began appearing in late 2023. Multivariable analysis indicated higher odds of SARI-confirmed positivity among children aged 5-14 years (adjusted OR (aOR)=1.85; 95% CI 1.47 to 2.31) and adults 50-64 years (aOR=1.36; 95% CI 1.15 to 1.60) compared with adults 25-49 years, during the rainy season (aOR=2.09; 95% CI 1.89 to 2.32) and among patients in Phnom Penh compared with other regions (p<0.001). Influenza detection markedly increased from 2022 to 2024 following the decline observed during the COVID-19 pandemic. CONCLUSION: These results indicate that there was an increase in SARI trends over the periods and the changing influenza subtypes circulating each year, along with a high mortality rate during the Delta variant COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia. Age, region, year and season were significant factors associated with SARI-confirmed positivity. Targeted interventions and preventive measures should be prioritised for specific high-risk groups.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed the epidemiology of influenza and SARS-CoV-2 among severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) patients in Cambodia from 2020 to 2024. It aimed to understand the trends and determinants of SARI-confirmed positivity. The study used data from nine sentinel hospitals and found that 13.5% of SARI cases were laboratory-confirmed for influenza or SARS-CoV-2. A(H3N2) was dominant in 2020, followed by SARS-CoV-2 in 2021, and A(H1N1)pdm09 in 2023. In 2024, A(H3N2) reemerged, with B(Victoria) and SARS-CoV-2 also detected. The evidence is moderate due to the retrospective design and potential biases in surveillance data.

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果深入了解了季节性流感病毒在柬埔寨的流行病学动态,强调需要在特定季节和地区对高危人群采取有针对性的干预和预防措施。

papers.title: A cohort study of persons exposed to highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) at premises with infected animals, England, 2023 to 2025
papers.abstract: BACKGROUNDThe ongoing panzootic of highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) presents a risk to human health both from infections resulting from exposure to infected birds or mammals, and from potential mutations enabling human-to-human transmission of a virus to which there is little or no population immunity.AIMThis cohort study was designed with the aim of informing assessments of the risk of avian influenza to human health and the public health management of influenza A(H5N1) exposures.METHODSWe recruited 428 individuals at 34 highly pathogenic avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreak sites between April 2023 to March 2025, throughout England. Through nasopharyngeal samples and questionnaires, we investigated risk factors including exposure periods and usage of personal protective equipment (PPE), and characteristics of influenza A(H5N1) infection.RESULTSThe median participant age was 37 years (interquartile range: 28-51 years), 296 (69%) were male. Most participants (85%) reported full PPE use when exposed, and 82 (19%) were vaccinated against seasonal influenza. Six persons tested PCR-positive for influenza A(H5N1), of whom three (< 1%) met the case definition for infection (two confirmed, one unclear) attributable to exposure periods. No severe illness was reported; no secondary cases were identified. None of the six cases with positive detections were vaccinated against seasonal influenza; two of them reported not wearing full PPE when exposed.CONCLUSIONWe recommend continued conscientious PPE use and the resumption of enhanced surveillance following detection of an increased risk of animal-human transmission, with a One Health focus, to mitigate pandemic risk of influenza A(H5N1).

papers.title: Stochastic intracellular replication dynamics shape population-level evolution in Influenza A Virus
papers.abstract: Abstract Understanding the sources of genetic diversity in Influenza A Virus (IAV) infections is crucial for understanding the mechanisms of viral evolution and immune escape. Whereas prior studies have characterized the effects of population bottlenecks during host-to-host transmission and intrahost tissue-to-tissue dissemination, the role of intracellular replication processes on IAV genetic diversity remains largely unexplored. In this study, we used stochastic mathematical modeling to simulate the replication of genetically distinct IAV strains within individual cells and tissues. Our results reveal significant bottleneck effects within a single infection cycle of individual cells. Intracellular bottleneck effects are driven by stochastic molecular processes and lead to the expansion or elimination of neutral variants creating large-scale differences between the initial and final frequencies of genetic variants in individual cells. By expanding our findings to a population-level model, we show that IAV intracellular replication reduces the effective population size, thereby diminishing the impact of selection and increasing the role of genetic drift. Our findings highlight the impact of intracellular replication processes on IAV genetic diversity.

papers.title_zh: 随机细胞内复制动态塑造甲型流感病毒群体水平的 进化
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Understanding the sources of genetic diversity in Influenza A Virus (IAV) infections is crucial for understanding the mechanisms of viral evolution and immune escape. Whereas prior studies have characterized the effects of population bottlenecks during host-to-host transmission and intrahost tissue-to-tissue dissemination, the role of intracellular replication processes on IAV genetic diversity remains largely unexplored. In this study, we used stochastic mathematical modeling to simulate the replication of genetically distinct IAV strains within individual cells and tissues. Our results reveal significant bottleneck effects within a single infection cycle of individual cells. Intracellular bottleneck effects are driven by stochastic molecular processes and lead to the expansion or elimination of neutral variants creating large-scale differences between the initial and final frequencies of genetic variants in individual cells. By expanding our findings to a population-level model, we show that IAV intracellular replication reduces the effective population size, thereby diminishing the impact of selection and increasing the role of genetic drift. Our findings highlight the impact of intracellular replication processes on IAV genetic diversity.

papers.title: Transcriptomic and proteomic signatures following AS03-adjuvanted Influenza A/H7N9 vaccine
papers.abstract: Introduction Vaccines targeting avian influenza virus A/H7N9 are poorly immunogenic. While the immune responses can be improved with oil-in-water emulsion adjuvants such as Adjuvant System 03 (AS03), the cellular mechanisms underpinning the adjuvant effect are incompletely characterized and poorly understood. Methods We enrolled 30 healthy adult participants and used RNA sequencing and quantitative proteomics to characterize the response to two doses of the influenza A/H7N9 vaccine, with and without AS03, in six immune cell types. These responses were compared to those seen after administration of an unadjuvanted seasonal in uenza A/H3N2 variant vaccine to identify signatures unique to adjuvanted influenza vaccines and correlated with later antibody responses. Transcriptomic and proteomic analyses revealed that. Results AS03-adjuvanted vaccine was associated with upregulation of immune pathways in innate immune cells within 24h following vaccination for phagocytosis, antigen presentation and processing, inflammasome activation, NK-cell mediated cytotoxicity, IgA production, and interferon-response pathways. Moreover, while major histocompatibility complex (MHC I and II) upregulation was observed across multiple immune cell types, MHCII gene transcription was also increased in the neutrophil compartment, generating the hypothesis that neutrophils may play a more important role in antigen presentation than previously understood. Discussion Taken together, these data provide a more complete mechanistic understanding of oil-in-water adjuvants and their role in enhancing the immune response for pandemic influenza preparedness. Clinical Trial Registration https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT02921997?term=NCT02921997&viewType , idientifier NCT02921997.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Avian-origin influenza A/H7N9 vaccines are poorly immunogenic in humans, and the cellular mechanisms by which oil-in-water emulsion adjuvants such as AS03 enhance immune responses remain incompletely characterized.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study enrolled 30 healthy adults and used RNA sequencing and quantitative proteomics to profile responses to two doses of an AS03-adjuvanted A/H7N9 vaccine across six immune cell types, comparing these responses to those elicited by an unadjuvanted seasonal A/H3N2 vaccine.
analysis.methods: Transcriptomic and proteomic profiling were performed to identify immune signatures unique to the AS03-adjuvanted vaccine and to correlate these signatures with subsequent antibody responses.
analysis.main_results: AS03-adjuvanted vaccination upregulated immune pathways in innate immune cells within 24 hours, including phagocytosis, antigen presentation and processing, inflammasome activation, NK-cell mediated cytotoxicity, IgA production, and interferon-response pathways.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings provide a mechanistic framework for how AS03 enhances vaccine immunogenicity, highlighting the role of neutrophils in MHCII-mediated antigen presentation as a previously underappreciated component of adjuvanted vaccine responses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These results inform pandemic influenza preparedness by identifying early transcriptomic and proteomic signatures that may guide the development and evaluation of adjuvanted vaccines against emerging influenza strains.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its small sample size and the absence of a non-adjuvanted A/H7N9 comparator arm, which constrains generalizability and the strength of causal inference; the evidence is assessed as moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated why AS03-adjuvanted A/H7N9 vaccines are more immunogenic than unadjuvanted formulations by profiling early transcriptomic and proteomic responses in six immune cell types among 30 healthy adults. Using RNA sequencing and quantitative proteomics, the authors found that AS03-adjuvanted vaccination rapidly upregulated pathways involved in phagocytosis, antigen presentation, inflammasome activation, NK-cell cytotoxicity, IgA production, and interferon responses within 24 hours. Notably, MHCII gene transcription increased in neutrophils, suggesting a previously unrecognized role for these cells in antigen presentation. The findings provide mechanistic insights into how AS03 enhances vaccine-induced immunity and may inform the design of adjuvanted vaccines for pandemic preparedness.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 禽源甲型/H7N9流感疫苗在人体中的免疫原性很差,并且水包油乳剂佐剂(例如AS03)增强免疫应答的细胞机制仍未完全表征。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究招募了 30 名健康成年人,并使用 RNA 测序和定量蛋白质组学来分析六种免疫细胞类型对两剂 AS03 佐剂的 A/H7N9 疫苗 的反应,并将这些反应与未佐剂的季节性 A/H3N2 疫苗 引起的反应进行比较。
elements_zh.methods: 进行转录组学和蛋白质组学分析,以鉴定 AS03 佐剂的 疫苗 独特的免疫特征,并将这些特征与随后的抗体反应相关联。
elements_zh.main_results: AS03佐剂的疫苗接种在24小时内上调先天免疫细胞中的免疫途径,包括吞噬作用、抗原呈递和加工、炎性体激活、NK细胞介导的细胞毒性、IgA产生和干扰素反应途径。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 这些发现为 AS03 如何增强 疫苗 免疫原性提供了一个机制框架,强调了中性粒细胞在 MHCII 介导的抗原呈递中的作用,作为佐剂 疫苗 反应中先前未被充分认识的组成部分。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些结果通过识别早期转录组和蛋白质组特征为大流行性流感做好准备提供信息,这些特征可以指导针对新出现的流感病毒株的佐剂 疫苗 的开发和评估。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到样本量小和缺乏无佐剂的 A/H7N9 比较臂的限制,这限制了普遍性和因果推理的强度;证据被评估为中等。

papers.title: Identifying the viral and epidemiological factors behind the apparent global extinction of influenza B/Yamagata
papers.abstract: Until 2020, two lineages of the influenza B virus had co-circulated globally. The COVID-19 pandemic led to a near-absence of influenza infections. While B/Victoria reemerged in late 2021, there have been no reports of B/Yamagata since the pandemic. To investigate which epidemiological and immunological factors were primarily responsible for the extinction of B/Yamagata, we developed a global model for the two influenza B lineages. To mimic the transmission impacts of the pandemic, we implemented a transient reduction in contacts and identified parameter values that recapitulated viral coexistence dynamic before the pandemic and the qualitative post-pandemic outcomes of B/Victoria (reemergence in late 2021) and B/Yamagata (extinction). Our results suggest that, rather than immunological or evolutionary mechanisms, the extinction of B/Yamagata was mainly driven by its lower basic reproduction number making the virus particularly vulnerable during the early phase of the pandemic. Stochastic simulations of our best-fitting model suggest that B/Victoria was also close to extinction during this period. We investigate the model to assess the feasibility of B/Victoria eradication through vaccination and the potential for a sustained re-emergence of B/Yamagata in the 2026-27 flu season, thus highlighting important considerations for biosafety. SignificanceFor decades, the Yamagata and Victoria lineages of the influenza B virus co-circulated globally, causing millions of infections in humans. Only Victoria reemerged after the COVID-19 pandemic. By combining mechanistic transmission modeling with worldwide influenza surveillance data, we show that Yamagatas extinction is most consistent with a lower intrinsic transmissibility than that of the surviving Victoria lineage. Contrary to other proposed explanations, differences in cross-immunity and immune escape appear insufficient to explain the observed outcome. Our analyses further indicate that Victoria narrowly avoided extinction during the COVID-19 disruption, but now transmission of Yamagata would be sustained if the lineage were reintroduced. These results inform both influenza eradication efforts and biosafety policy.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed why the influenza B/Yamagata lineage appeared to go globally extinct after the COVID-19 pandemic while the B/Victoria lineage reemerged. It sought to determine whether epidemiological or immunological factors were primarily responsible for the extinction of B/Yamagata.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors developed a global mechanistic transmission model for the two influenza B lineages (B/Victoria and B/Yamagata) to simulate their dynamics before and after the COVID-19 pandemic.
analysis.methods: A global model was constructed to simulate influenza B transmission dynamics, incorporating a transient reduction in contacts to mimic pandemic impacts. Parameter values were identified to recapitulate pre-pandemic coexistence and post-pandemic outcomes for both lineages.
analysis.main_results: The model indicated that B/Yamagata’s extinction was primarily driven by its lower basic reproduction number, making it particularly vulnerable during the early pandemic phase. Stochastic simulations suggested B/Victoria was also close to extinction during this period.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that differences in intrinsic transmissibility, rather than cross-immunity or immune escape, best explained B/Yamagata’s extinction. They highlighted that their analysis uniquely combined mechanistic modeling with worldwide surveillance data to test competing hypotheses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform influenza eradication strategies and biosafety policies by demonstrating that B/Yamagata’s extinction was likely due to its lower transmissibility, while also showing that B/Victoria narrowly avoided extinction and could sustain transmission if reintroduced.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study relies on a modeling framework and does not include empirical immunological or evolutionary data, which limits direct confirmation of mechanisms. The evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of experimental validation and reliance on surveillance data.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the apparent global extinction of the influenza B/Yamagata lineage after the COVID-19 pandemic, contrasting it with the reemergence of B/Victoria. Using a global mechanistic transmission model, the authors simulated pre- and post-pandemic dynamics by incorporating a transient reduction in contacts. Their results indicated that B/Yamagata’s extinction was primarily driven by its lower basic reproduction number, making it vulnerable during pandemic disruptions, while B/Victoria narrowly avoided extinction. The analysis ruled out cross-immunity or immune escape as primary explanations. The findings suggest that intrinsic transmissibility differences explain the observed outcomes and inform influenza eradication and biosafety policies, particularly regarding the potential for B/Yamagata’s reintroduction.

papers.abstract_zh: 直到 2020 年,两种乙型流感病毒谱系在全球范围内共同传播。COVID-19 大流行导致几乎没有流感感染。虽然 B/Victoria 于 2021 年底重新出现,但自大流行以来尚未有 B/Yamagata 的报告。为了调查哪些流行病学和免疫学因素是导致 B/Yamagata 灭绝的主要原因,我们开发了两个 B 型流感谱系的全球模型。为了模拟大流行的 传播 影响,我们暂时减少了接触,并确定了参数值,这些参数值概括了大流行之前的病毒共存动态以及 B/Victoria(于 2021 年底重新出现)和 B/Yamagata(灭绝)的大流行后定性结果。我们的结果表明,B/Yamagata 的灭绝主要是由于其较低的基本繁殖数,而不是免疫学或进化机制,使得该病毒在大流行的早期阶段特别脆弱。我们的最佳拟合模型的随机模拟表明,B/Victoria 在此期间也接近灭绝。我们研究了该模型,以评估通过 疫苗接种 根除 B/Victoria 的可行性以及 B/Yamagata 在 2026-27 流感季节持续重新出现的可能性,从而强调生物安全的重要考虑因素。意义 几十年来,乙型流感病毒的山形和维多利亚谱系在全球范围内共同传播,导致数百万人感染。在 COVID-19 大流行之后,只有维多利亚重新出现。通过将机制 传播 模型与全球流感 监测 数据相结合,我们发现山形灭绝与幸存的维多利亚谱系相比较低的内在传播率最为一致。与其他提出的解释相反,交叉免疫和免疫逃逸的差异似乎不足以解释观察到的结果。我们的分析进一步表明,维多利亚在 COVID-19 破坏期间勉强避免了灭绝,但现在如果重新引入该谱系,山形的 传播 将得以维持。这些结果为根除流感工作和生物安全政策提供了信息。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解释了为什么 B/Yamagata 谱系在 COVID-19 大流行后似乎在全球范围内灭绝,而 B/Victoria 谱系却重新出现。它试图确定流行病学因素还是免疫学因素是否是 B/Yamagata 灭绝的主要原因。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 作者为两种 B 型流感谱系(B/Victoria 和 B/Yamagata)开发了一个全局机制 传播 模型,以模拟它们在 COVID-19 大流行之前和之后的动态。
analysis_zh.methods: 构建了一个全球模型来模拟乙型流感 传播 动态,其中包括接触量的暂时减少以模拟大流行的影响。确定参数值以概括两个谱系在大流行前的共存和大流行后的结果。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该模型表明,B/Yamagata 的灭绝主要是由于其较低的基本繁殖数,使其在大流行早期阶段特别脆弱。随机模拟表明 B/Victoria 在此期间也濒临灭绝。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,内在传播性的差异,而不是交叉免疫或免疫逃逸,最能解释 B/Yamagata 的灭绝。他们强调,他们的分析独特地将机械模型与全球 监测 数据相结合,以测试相互竞争的假设。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,B/Yamagata 的灭绝可能是由于其较低的传播性,同时还表明 B/Victoria 勉强避免了灭绝,并且如果重新引入,可以维持 传播,从而为流感根除策略和生物安全政策提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究依赖于建模框架,不包括经验免疫学或进化数据,这限制了机制的直接确认。由于缺乏实验验证且依赖 监测 数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Detection and characterization of antiviral-resistant viruses during the influenza season of 2024-25.
papers.abstract: UNLABELLED: During the high severity season of 2024-25, CDC with public health partners sequenced and analyzed genomes of >10,000 influenza viruses for antiviral resistance markers. Available sequence-flagged and representative viruses were tested with antivirals using in vitro assays. In the US, three oseltamivir-resistant A(H3N2) viruses had treatment-emergent neuraminidase (NA) mutations, either E119V or R292K. Oseltamivir-resistant A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses with NA-H275Y were detected in 15 states, albeit at a low frequency (0.53%). They belonged to several phylogenetic groups, with hemagglutinin (HA) subclade D.3.1 combined with either NA subclade D.1 or D.2 being most common. Based on shared sequence data, nearly all H275Y viruses from Australia, Canada, and Chile also belonged to these HA and NA subclades. Conversely, most H275Y viruses (68/81) from China belonged to HA subclade C.1.9 and NA subclade D and shared the permissive mutation R257K. Influenza polymerase acidic (PA) mutations conferring 4- to 92-fold decreased baloxavir susceptibility were detected in nine influenza A viruses. Viruses with PA-I38T showed mild attenuation of replicative fitness in three cell lines. Based on available data, NA-H275Y and PA-I38T viruses were collected from patients with no exposure to antivirals. Baseline susceptibility to all US-approved influenza antivirals remained largely unchanged compared to previous seasons. All swine-origin viruses detected in the US had adamantane resistance-conferring marker, M2-S31N, but remained susceptible to other approved antivirals. Monitoring antiviral susceptibility has substantially improved with increased sequencing capacities and bioinformatic support at public health laboratories. Information gained through influenza surveillance has been used to guide recommendations on antiviral use. IMPORTANCE: Circulation of influenza viruses with reduced susceptibility to antivirals can diminish the usefulness of medications prescribed for influenza. This study informs on the prevalence of drug-resistant influenza viruses in the US during the high severity season of 2024-25. It provides information on susceptibility profile to all approved antiviral medications and on replicative fitness of representative drug-resistant viruses. Most drug-resistant viruses were collected from patients who were not exposed to antivirals indicating their ability to transmit from human to human. Whole-genome sequence (WGS)-based analysis is the cornerstone for surveillance, and numerous laboratories have been utilizing this approach. However, CDC laboratory is the only laboratory in the US conducting phenotypic testing of circulating viruses needed to confirm the outcomes of sequence-based analysis and to identify new molecular markers of resistance. Data gathered through virologic surveillance give much-needed information on drug susceptibility of influenza viruses which are used to guide recommendations on antiviral use.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addressed the public-health need to monitor seasonal influenza viruses for reduced susceptibility to antiviral drugs during the high-severity 2024–25 season, when circulation of resistant variants could undermine treatment effectiveness. It aimed to quantify antiviral resistance markers and assess their impact on drug susceptibility and viral fitness.
analysis.study_design_and_population: CDC and public-health partners sequenced and analyzed genomes of more than 10,000 influenza viruses collected during the 2024–25 US influenza season. Sequence-flagged and representative viruses were tested in vitro for antiviral susceptibility.
analysis.methods: Whole-genome sequencing identified antiviral resistance markers, and phenotypic assays measured drug susceptibility of circulating viruses. CDC’s laboratory performed phenotypic testing to confirm sequence-based predictions and to identify new molecular markers of resistance.
analysis.main_results: Oseltamivir-resistant A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses with NA-H275Y were detected in 15 states at a low frequency of 0.53%. Influenza polymerase acidic (PA) mutations conferring 4- to 92-fold decreased baloxavir susceptibility were detected in nine influenza A viruses, and PA-I38T showed mild attenuation of replicative fitness in three cell lines.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the low but persistent circulation of NA-H275Y and PA-I38T viruses as evidence of human-to-human transmission despite no reported antiviral exposure in most patients. They highlighted the utility of whole-genome sequencing for surveillance and the necessity of phenotypic confirmation to validate sequence-based resistance predictions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform antiviral stewardship by documenting the prevalence and fitness of drug-resistant seasonal influenza viruses, guiding recommendations on antiviral use and supporting the expansion of sequencing-based surveillance capacity in public-health laboratories.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s strength is bolstered by large-scale sequencing and phenotypic confirmation, but reliance on CDC laboratory for phenotypic testing limits throughput and generalizability. The evidence is moderate due to the absence of detailed clinical exposure data and potential under-detection of resistance outside sentinel sites.

analysis.summary_en: During the 2024–25 US influenza season, CDC and partners sequenced over 10,000 viruses and tested representative isolates for antiviral susceptibility. Oseltamivir-resistant A(H1N1)pdm09 viruses carrying NA-H275Y were detected in 15 states at a low frequency of 0.53%, while baloxavir-resistant viruses with PA mutations showed 4- to 92-fold reduced susceptibility and mild fitness attenuation in vitro. Most resistant viruses were collected from patients without reported antiviral exposure, suggesting onward human transmission. Whole-genome sequencing underpinned surveillance, but phenotypic confirmation remained centralized at CDC, constraining scalability. These data guide antiviral stewardship and underscore the value of integrating sequencing with phenotypic testing to monitor resistance in seasonal influenza.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了公共卫生需要监测 季节性流感 病毒,以降低在 2024-25 年严重程度期间对 抗病毒药物 药物的敏感性,此时耐药变异的传播可能会破坏 治疗 的有效性。其目的是量化 抗病毒药物 耐药标记并评估其对药物敏感性和病毒适应性的影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: CDC 和公共卫生合作伙伴对 2024-25 年美国流感季节期间收集的 10,000 多种流感病毒进行了 基因组 测序和分析。在体外测试了序列标记病毒和代表性病毒的 抗病毒药物 敏感性。
elements_zh.methods: 全 基因组 测序鉴定了 抗病毒药物 抗性标记,表型分析测量了循环病毒的药物敏感性。疾病预防控制中心的实验室进行了表型测试,以确认基于序列的预测并确定新的耐药分子标记。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 15 个州以 0.53% 的低频率检测到带有 NA-H275Y 的奥司他韦耐药 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09 病毒。在 9 种甲型流感病毒中检测到流感聚合酶酸性 (PA) 突变 使巴洛沙韦敏感性降低 4 至 92 倍,PA-I38T 在三种细胞系中显示复制适应性轻度减弱。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 NA-H275Y 和 PA-I38T 病毒的低但持续的循环解释为人与人之间 传播 的证据,尽管大多数患者没有报告 传播 暴露。他们强调了 基因组 测序对 监测 的实用性以及表型确认以验证基于序列的抗性预测的必要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过记录 患病率 和耐药 季节性流感 病毒的适应性、指导 抗病毒药物 使用建议并支持扩大公共卫生实验室中基于测序的 监测 能力,为 抗病毒药物 管理提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的优势得益于大规模测序和表型确认,但对 CDC 实验室进行表型测试的依赖限制了通量和普遍性。由于缺乏详细的临床暴露数据以及哨点之外的耐药性可能未检测到,因此证据是中等的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了公共卫生需要监测 季节性流感 病毒,以降低在 2024-25 年严重程度期间对 抗病毒药物 药物的敏感性,此时耐药变异的传播可能会破坏 治疗 的有效性。其目的是量化 抗病毒药物 耐药标记并评估其对药物敏感性和病毒适应性的影响。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: CDC 和公共卫生合作伙伴对 2024-25 年美国流感季节期间收集的 10,000 多种流感病毒进行了 基因组 测序和分析。在体外测试了序列标记病毒和代表性病毒的 抗病毒药物 敏感性。
analysis_zh.methods: 全 基因组 测序鉴定了 抗病毒药物 抗性标记,表型分析测量了循环病毒的药物敏感性。疾病预防控制中心的实验室进行了表型测试,以确认基于序列的预测并确定新的耐药分子标记。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在 15 个州以 0.53% 的低频率检测到带有 NA-H275Y 的奥司他韦耐药 甲型H1N1流感病毒pdm09 病毒。在 9 种甲型流感病毒中检测到流感聚合酶酸性 (PA) 突变 使巴洛沙韦敏感性降低 4 至 92 倍,PA-I38T 在三种细胞系中显示复制适应性轻度减弱。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将 NA-H275Y 和 PA-I38T 病毒的低但持续的循环解释为人与人之间 传播 的证据,尽管大多数患者没有报告 传播 暴露。他们强调了 基因组 测序对 监测 的实用性以及表型确认以验证基于序列的抗性预测的必要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现通过记录 患病率 和耐药 季节性流感 病毒的适应性、指导 抗病毒药物 使用建议并支持扩大公共卫生实验室中基于测序的 监测 能力,为 抗病毒药物 管理提供信息。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的优势得益于大规模测序和表型确认,但对 CDC 实验室进行表型测试的依赖限制了通量和普遍性。由于缺乏详细的临床暴露数据以及哨点之外的耐药性可能未检测到,因此证据是中等的。

papers.title: Identification and computational analysis of B-cell epitopes on the hemagglutinin protein of the H3N2 influenza virus.
papers.abstract: Influenza A virus (IAV) is a highly infectious enveloped RNA virus that primarily causes respiratory disease. Continuous antigenic variation in influenza virus hemagglutinin (HA) is a major driver of influenza pandemics. Therefore, precise identification of B-cell epitopes within HA is essential for developing diagnostic tools and vaccine candidates that can help limit further influenza spread. In the present study, an integrated experimental and bioinformatics strategy was used. A trimeric HA protein was rationally designed to improve antigenicity and immunogenicity, expressed in a mammalian eukaryotic expression system, and purified by Ni-affinity chromatography. After animal immunization, nine HA-specific monoclonal antibodies (mAbs), namely 5D5, 6B8, 9E7, 13F8, 14C3, 15F6, 16B5, 17H7, and 20C5, were generated. These mAbs specifically recognized HA protein in western blotting and indirect immunofluorescence assays (IFA). B-cell epitopes on HA were subsequently mapped using these mAbs by indirect enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), dot-blot, western blotting, and IFA. Six previously unreported linear B-cell epitopes were identified: 21 GNDNSTATL 29 , 41 IVKTITNDR 49 , 116 YDVPDYASL 124 , 382 DLKSTQAAI 390 , 458 SEMNKLFEK 466 , and 488 KCDNACIGS 496 . Bioinformatics analysis further revealed the spatial distribution and structural characteristics of these epitope regions on HA. These findings expand the current understanding of HA epitopes and provide a theoretical basis for developing IAV subunit vaccines and highly sensitive detection methods.

analysis.methods: B-cell epitopes on HA were mapped using the generated monoclonal antibodies through indirect enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA), dot-blot, western blotting, and indirect immunofluorescence assays (IFA). analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to identify B-cell epitopes on the hemagglutinin (HA) protein of influenza A virus to support vaccine and diagnostic development. The authors designed a trimeric HA protein, expressed it in a mammalian system, and generated nine HA-specific monoclonal antibodies. Using these antibodies, six previously unreported linear B-cell epitopes were mapped on HA through ELISA, dot-blot, western blotting, and IFA. Bioinformatics analysis further characterized the spatial and structural features of these epitopes. The findings expand the understanding of HA epitopes and provide a theoretical basis for developing subunit vaccines and sensitive detection methods. However, the study’s reliance on animal-derived antibodies and in vitro methods limits direct applicability to human immunity, warranting further validation in clinical contexts.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 甲型流感病毒会引起季节性呼吸道疾病,其血凝素 (HA) 蛋白会发生持续的抗原变异,从而引发大流行。这项研究是必要的,因为精确鉴定 HA 内的 B 细胞表位对于开发诊断工具和 疫苗 候选药物以限制流感传播至关重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用综合实验和生物信息学策略设计了一种三聚体HA蛋白,该蛋白在哺乳动物真核系统中表达并通过Ni亲和层析纯化。动物免疫后,生成并表征了九种 HA 特异性单克隆抗体。
elements_zh.methods: 通过间接酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA)、斑点印迹、蛋白质印迹和间接免疫荧光测定 (IFA),使用生成的单克隆抗体绘制 HA 上的 B 细胞表位。利用生物信息学进一步分析表位区域的空间分布和结构特征。
elements_zh.main_results: Six previously unreported linear B-cell epitopes were identified: 21GNDNSTATL29, 41IVKTITNDR49, 116YDVPDYASL124, 382DLKSTQAAI390, 458SEMNKLFEK466, and 488KCDNACIGS496. Bioinformatics analysis revealed their spatial distribution and structural characteristics on HA.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为扩大了目前对 HA 表位的理解,并为开发亚基 疫苗 和高灵敏度检测方法提供了理论基础。新颖之处在于 HA 蛋白上六个新的线性 B 细胞表位的鉴定。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改进的流感亚基 疫苗 的设计和针对新鉴定的表位的诊断测定提供信息。它们可以增强 疫苗 的功效,并能够更准确地检测循环流感病毒株。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其依赖体外表位作图和动物源性单克隆抗体而受到限制,这可能无法完全反映人类 免疫应答。由于缺乏人体临床验证且表位表征范围有限,证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 甲型流感病毒会引起季节性呼吸道疾病,其血凝素 (HA) 蛋白会发生持续的抗原变异,从而引发大流行。这项研究是必要的,因为精确鉴定 HA 内的 B 细胞表位对于开发诊断工具和 疫苗 候选药物以限制流感传播至关重要。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用综合实验和生物信息学策略设计了一种三聚体HA蛋白,该蛋白在哺乳动物真核系统中表达并通过Ni亲和层析纯化。动物免疫后,生成并表征了九种 HA 特异性单克隆抗体。
analysis_zh.methods: 通过间接酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA)、斑点印迹、蛋白质印迹和间接免疫荧光测定 (IFA),使用生成的单克隆抗体绘制 HA 上的 B 细胞表位。利用生物信息学进一步分析表位区域的空间分布和结构特征。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这些发现解释为扩大了目前对 HA 表位的理解,并为开发亚基 疫苗 和高灵敏度检测方法提供了理论基础。新颖之处在于 HA 蛋白上六个新的线性 B 细胞表位的鉴定。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为改进的流感亚基 疫苗 的设计和针对新鉴定的表位的诊断测定提供信息。它们可以增强 疫苗 的功效,并能够更准确地检测循环流感病毒株。

papers.title: Probe-based metagenomic sentinel surveillance of viral respiratory infections in primary care: a prospective, national, pilot study.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: With the introduction of metagenomics in clinical diagnostics unfolding and the expanding role of pathogen genomics in national surveillance, conditions are favourable for the further maturation of these approaches in public health surveillance. In this study, we aimed to pilot the use of probe-based metagenomics for nationwide sentinel surveillance through general practitioner (GP) networks and for the genomic characterisation of both anticipated and emerging respiratory viruses in primary care. METHODS: This prospective, pilot study included patients with acute respiratory illness attending GP practices participating in nationwide sentinel virological surveillance in the Netherlands, from Jan 10, 2025, to April 25, 2025. On predefined selection days, 90-100 combined nasopharyngeal and oropharyngeal swab specimens were analysed through parallel metagenomic testing using probes targeting 15 488 strains of human and animal viruses. Results were compared with a standard two-tiered surveillance strategy comprising PCR targeting 17 viruses, followed by amplicon-based nanopore whole-genome sequencing of influenza viruses, SARS-CoV-2, and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV). The primary outcome was detection and in-depth genomic characterisation of viruses within and beyond the scope of standard screening. Sensitivity, specificity, positive and negative predictive values, and genome coverage were analysed. FINDINGS: 93 patients were included, with a median age of 51 years (IQR 33-67); 55 (59%) were women and 38 (41%) were men. Overall, 74 (80%) specimens tested positive through standard PCR-based screening. Metagenomic surveillance detected viruses in 88 (95%) specimens, including DNA viruses known to establish latent infections. For viruses targeted by routine PCR, metagenomics showed a pooled sensitivity of 93·8% (95% CI 88·1-98·7), specificity of 99·8% (95% CI 99·5-100·0), positive predictive value of 96·2% (95% CI 91·8-100·0), and negative predictive value of 99·7% (95% CI 91·8-100·0), with a median genome coverage of 99·4% (IQR 96·9-99·9%). Metagenomic data enabled simultaneous full genomic characterisation of circulating viruses targeted by current amplicon-based surveillance, including influenza viruses (success rate 30 [86%] of 35 detections) and RSV (six [86%] of seven), and of viruses that were post hoc characterised by whole-genome sequencing in response to epidemiological findings during the study period (human metapneumoviruses [hMPV], five [50·0%] of ten), and non-targeted viruses such as adenoviruses. The data facilitated characterisation of a reassortant A(H3N2) influenza virus, potential vaccine escape mutants, markers of susceptibility to influenza antiviral drugs and RSV monoclonal antibodies, and a human A(H1N2)v influenza virus infection. INTERPRETATION: The technically robust and comprehensive performance across heterogeneous circulating viruses shown here supports evaluation in larger prospective studies in high-prevalence settings, where implementation might be most cost-efficient. Further optimisation of probe-based enrichment strategies could reduce turnaround time and facilitate integration into routine public health surveillance. FUNDING: The Netherlands Organisation for Health Research and Development (ZonMw), and the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport (VWS).

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to pilot the use of probe-based metagenomics for nationwide sentinel surveillance of viral respiratory infections in primary care. The research focused on detecting and characterising both anticipated and emerging respiratory viruses, including seasonal influenza A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria lineage. The study included 93 patients with acute respiratory illness in the Netherlands, from January 10 to April 25, 2025. Metagenomic testing identified viruses in 88% of specimens, including DNA viruses and influenza variants. The results demonstrated high sensitivity and specificity for targeted viruses, with comprehensive genomic characterisation. The findings suggest that probe-based metagenomics could be a valuable tool for public health surveillance, especially in high-prevalence settings. However, the study was limited to a pilot scale and requires further validation in larger studies.

papers.title: Prognostic Value of Clinical and Laboratory Markers in Hospitalized Influenza-Positive Patients: A Retrospective Cohort Study With ROC-Based Risk Stratification.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Seasonal influenza continues to cause substantial morbidity and mortality worldwide. Identifying reliable clinical and paraclinical predictors of adverse outcomes may aid in early triage and management. This study aimed to evaluate clinical and paraclinical factors associated with prolonged hospitalization, ICU admission, and in-hospital mortality in influenza‐positive patients. METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed 294 RT-PCR-confirmed influenza cases admitted to Ayatollah Rouhani Hospital (Babol, Iran) during fall-winter 2022-2023. Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were extracted. Key outcomes were prolonged hospital stay (> 5 days), ICU admission, and in-hospital death. Logistic regression and ROC analysis were used to identify independent predictors and cutoff values. RESULTS: Prolonged hospitalization occurred in 43.5% of patients, ICU admission in 8.8%, and mortality in 5.0%. In multivariate analysis, opium use (OR: 5.4), renal disease (OR: 9.27), and LDH > 1000 (OR: 8.74) were significantly associated with longer hospital stay. LDH > 1000 also predicted ICU admission (OR: 46.9) and mortality (OR: 21.7). Oxygen saturation < 93% increased mortality risk (OR: 7.98). ROC analysis identified LDH ≥ 633 and CRP ≥ 88.5 as optimal cutoffs for predicting mortality. CONCLUSION: Readily available markers such as LDH, CRP, liver enzymes, and oxygen saturation, which showed significant associations with prolonged hospitalization, ICU admission, or mortality in our analyses, may assist in early risk stratification of hospitalized influenza patients.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 季节性流感 继续在全球范围内造成大量发病率和 死亡率。确定不良结果的可靠临床和临床旁预测因素可能有助于早期分类和管理。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究分析了 2022 年至 2023 年秋冬期间阿亚图拉鲁哈尼医院(伊朗巴博尔)收治的 294 例 RT-PCR 确诊的流感病例。主要结局是住院时间延长(> 5 天)、入住 ICU 和院内死亡。
elements_zh.methods: 提取了人口统计、临床和实验室数据。使用逻辑回归和 ROC 分析来确定独立的预测因子和截止值。
elements_zh.main_results: 43.5%的患者出现住院时间延长,8.8%入住ICU,死亡率占5.0%。多变量分析显示,鸦片使用(优势比:5.4)、肾脏疾病(优势比:9.27)及乳酸脱氢酶(LDH)>1000(优势比:8.74)与住院时间延长显著相关。LDH >1000还可预测ICU入住(优势比:46.9)及死亡率(优势比:21.7)。血氧饱和度<93%可增加死亡率风险(优势比:7.98)。ROC分析显示,LDH≥633及C反应蛋白(CRP)≥88.5为预测死亡率的最佳截断值。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在我们的分析中,LDH、CRP、肝酶和氧饱和度等现成标记物与住院时间延长、入住 ICU 或 死亡率 显着相关,可能有助于对住院流感患者进行早期风险分层。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为住院流感患者的早期风险分层策略提供信息,从而有可能改善临床决策和资源分配。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是回顾性的,可能会引入偏差并限制建立因果关系的能力。由于该研究的观察性质,证据是中等的。

Identifying reliable clinical and paraclinical predictors of adverse outcomes may aid in early triage and management. This study aimed to evaluate clinical and paraclinical factors associated with prolonged hospitalization, ICU admission, and in-hospital mortality in influenza‐positive patients. METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed 294 RT-PCR-confirmed influenza cases admitted to Ayatollah Rouhani Hospital (Babol, Iran) during fall-winter 2022-2023. Demographic, clinical, and laboratory data were extracted. Key outcomes were prolonged hospital stay (> 5 days), ICU admission, and in-hospital death. Logistic regression and ROC analysis were used to identify independent predictors and cutoff values. RESULTS: Prolonged hospitalization occurred in 43.5% of patients, ICU admission in 8.8%, and mortality in 5.0%. In multivariate analysis, opium use (OR: 5.4), renal disease (OR: 9.27), and LDH > 1000 (OR: 8.74) were significantly associated with longer hospital stay. LDH > 1000 also predicted ICU admission (OR: 46.9) and mortality (OR: 21.7). Oxygen saturation < 93% increased mortality risk (OR: 7.98). ROC analysis identified LDH ≥ 633 and CRP ≥ 88.5 as optimal cutoffs for predicting mortality. CONCLUSION: Readily available markers such as LDH, CRP, liver enzymes, and oxygen saturation, which showed significant associations with prolonged hospitalization, ICU admission, or mortality in our analyses, may assist in early risk stratification of hospitalized influenza patients.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景与目的:季节性流感 仍在全球造成大量发病与死亡。识别可靠的临床与辅助检查预测因子,有助于早期分诊与管理。本研究旨在评估与甲型流感病毒阳性患者住院时间延长、ICU收治及院内 死亡率 相关的临床与辅助检查因素。方法:本回顾性研究纳入2022-2023年秋冬季在伊朗巴博尔阿亚图拉·鲁哈尼医院收治的294例RT-PCR确诊甲型流感病例。收集人口学、临床与实验室数据。主要结局为住院时间延长(>5天)、ICU收治及院内死亡。采用Logistic回归与ROC分析识别独立预测因子与截断值。结果:住院时间延长发生率为43.5%,ICU收治为8.8%,院内 死亡率 为5.0%。多因素分析显示,吸食鸦片(OR: 5.4)、肾脏疾病(OR: 9.27)及乳酸脱氢酶>1000 U/L(OR: 8.74)与住院时间延长显著相关;乳酸脱氢酶>1000 U/L还可预测ICU收治(OR: 46.9)与院内 死亡率(OR: 21.7);血氧饱和度<93%可增加院内 死亡率 风险(OR: 7.98)。ROC分析显示,乳酸脱氢酶≥633 U/L与C反应蛋白≥88.5 mg/L为预测院内 死亡率 的最佳截断值。结论:在本研究中,乳酸脱氢酶、C反应蛋白、肝酶及血氧饱和度等易获取指标与住院时间延长、ICU收治或院内 死亡率 显著相关,有助于甲型流感住院患者的早期风险分层。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 季节性流感 继续在全球范围内造成大量发病率和 死亡率。确定不良结果的可靠临床和临床旁预测因素可能有助于早期分类和管理。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性研究分析了 2022 年至 2023 年秋冬期间阿亚图拉鲁哈尼医院(伊朗巴博尔)收治的 294 例 RT-PCR 确诊的流感病例。主要结局是住院时间延长(> 5 天)、入住 ICU 和院内死亡。
analysis_zh.methods: 提取了人口统计、临床和实验室数据。使用逻辑回归和 ROC 分析来确定独立的预测因子和截止值。
analysis_zh.main_results: 43.5%的患者出现住院时间延长,8.8%入住ICU,死亡率占5.0%。多变量分析显示,鸦片使用(优势比:5.4)、肾脏疾病(优势比:9.27)及乳酸脱氢酶(LDH)>1000(优势比:8.74)与住院时间延长显著相关。LDH >1000还可预测ICU入住(优势比:46.9)及死亡率(优势比:21.7)。血氧饱和度<93%可增加死亡率风险(优势比:7.98)。ROC分析显示,LDH≥633及C反应蛋白(CRP)≥88.5为预测死亡率的最佳截断值。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 在我们的分析中,LDH、CRP、肝酶和氧饱和度等现成标记物与住院时间延长、入住 ICU 或 死亡率 显着相关,可能有助于对住院流感患者进行早期风险分层。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可能为住院流感患者的早期风险分层策略提供信息,从而有可能改善临床决策和资源分配。

papers.title: Influenza-associated excess mortality and subtype-specific contributions in a city in Guangxi, China: a generalized additive model analysis, 2022–2025
papers.abstract: Influenza poses a significant global disease burden, with impacts extending beyond the respiratory system to increase cardiovascular event risks. However, regional data on influenza-associated excess mortality, especially regarding subtype-specific contributions and high-risk populations, remain insufficient in Guangxi. This study aimed to explore influenza-associated excess all-cause, respiratory, and circulatory mortality and its population characteristics in a city in Guangxi from 2022 to 2025, providing evidence for targeted prevention and control. Weekly mortality data, influenza virological surveillance data (A/H3N2, A/H1N1, B/Victoria), meteorological data, and air pollution data (PM2. 5, NO2) were collected from the 14th week of 2022 to the 13th week of 2025 in a city in Guangxi. A generalized additive model (GAM) with a quasi-Poisson distribution was used to estimate influenza-associated excess mortality, adjusting for temperature, humidity, PM2.5, and NO2. The optimal lag structure was determined using QAIC-based model comparison. Excess mortality was estimated using counterfactual predictions with all influenza terms set to zero. Negative binomial models were fitted as a sensitivity analysis. The optimal lag structure was 4 weeks for all three influenza subtypes (A/H3N2, A/H1N1, and B/Victoria), 0 weeks for temperature and PM2.5, and 3 weeks for humidity and NO2. The model demonstrated substantial explanatory power for all-cause mortality (adjusted R2 = 0.7275, deviance explained = 77.9%). During the study period, the all-cause excess mortality rate was highest in 2023–2024 (42.36 per 100,000), followed by 2022–2023 (21.00 per 100,000) and 2024–2025 (15.57 per 100,000). Circulatory deaths constituted the majority of excess mortality across all seasons. The elderly population (≥ 65 years) bore the overwhelming majority of excess deaths (3,002 excess deaths). A/H3N2 showed the strongest association with mortality (IRR = 1.0017, P = 0.002). From 2022 to 2025, influenza-associated excess mortality in a city in Guangxi was characterized by a predominance of circulatory diseases and a concentration of risk among the elderly population, with A/H3N2 being the dominant pathogenic subtype.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Influenza imposes a substantial global health burden, including increased risks of cardiovascular events beyond respiratory illness. However, regional data on influenza-associated excess mortality, particularly subtype-specific contributions and high-risk populations, remain insufficient in Guangxi, China.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This ecological time-series study collected weekly mortality data, influenza virological surveillance data for A/H3N2, A/H1N1, and B/Victoria, meteorological data, and air pollution data (PM2.5, NO2) from a city in Guangxi between the 14th week of 2022 and the 13th week of 2025.
analysis.methods: A generalized additive model (GAM) with a quasi-Poisson distribution was used to estimate influenza-associated excess mortality, adjusting for temperature, humidity, PM2.5, and NO2. The optimal lag structure was determined using QAIC-based model comparison, with excess mortality estimated via counterfactual predictions setting all influenza terms to zero. Negative binomial models were fitted as a sensitivity analysis.
analysis.main_results: The model explained 77.9% of deviance in all-cause mortality (adjusted R2 = 0.7275). The all-cause excess mortality rate was highest in 2023–2024 (42.36 per 100,000), followed by 2022–2023 (21.00 per 100,000) and 2024–2025 (15.57 per 100,000). Circulatory deaths constituted the majority of excess mortality, and the elderly (≥65 years) accounted for 3,002 excess deaths. A/H3N2 showed the strongest association with mortality (IRR = 1.0017, P = 0.002).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights that influenza-associated excess mortality in Guangxi is predominantly circulatory, concentrated among the elderly, and most strongly linked to A/H3N2. This provides novel regional evidence on subtype-specific contributions and high-risk groups to inform targeted prevention strategies.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings support prioritizing A/H3N2-focused vaccination and enhanced circulatory disease monitoring in elderly populations in Guangxi. They also underscore the need for integrated surveillance incorporating meteorological and air pollution data to refine risk assessment.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The ecological design limits causal inference, and the study relies on aggregated data without individual-level clinical confirmation of influenza infection. The model's explanatory power is high for all-cause mortality, but subtype-specific estimates may be influenced by surveillance biases and unmeasured confounders, warranting cautious interpretation.

analysis.summary_en: This study quantified influenza-associated excess mortality in a city in Guangxi, China, from 2022 to 2025 using a generalized additive model adjusted for meteorological and air pollution factors. The model explained 77.9% of deviance in all-cause mortality, with the highest excess mortality rate in 2023–2024 (42.36 per 100,000). Circulatory deaths dominated excess mortality, and the elderly (≥65 years) accounted for 3,002 excess deaths. A/H3N2 showed the strongest association with mortality (IRR = 1.0017, P = 0.002). The findings highlight the predominance of circulatory disease in influenza-associated mortality, the concentration of risk in the elderly, and the dominant role of A/H3N2, providing regional evidence to guide targeted prevention and control strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 流感给全球健康带来了巨大的负担,包括呼吸系统疾病以外的心血管事件风险增加。然而,中国广西有关流感相关过量 死亡率 的区域数据,特别是亚型特异性贡献和高危人群的数据仍然不足。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项生态时间序列研究收集了广西某市2022年第14周至2025年第13周的每周死亡率数据、A/H3N2、A/H1N1和B/Victoria的流感病毒学监测数据、气象数据和空气污染数据(PM2.5、NO2)。
elements_zh.methods: 使用具有准泊松分布的广义加性模型 (GAM) 来估计流感相关的过量 死亡率,并根据温度、湿度、PM2.5 和 NO2 进行调整。使用基于 QAIC 的模型比较确定最佳滞后结构,并通过反事实预测将所有流感项设置为零来估计过量的 死亡率。拟合负二项式模型作为敏感性分析。
elements_zh.main_results: The model explained 77.9% of deviance in all-cause mortality (adjusted R2 = 0.7275). The all-cause excess mortality rate was highest in 2023–2024 (42.36 per 100,000), followed by 2022–2023 (21.00 per 100,000) and 2024–2025 (15.57 per 100,000). Circulatory deaths constituted the majority of excess mortality, and the elderly (≥65 years) accounted for 3,002 excess deaths. A/H3N2 showed the strongest association with mortality (IRR = 1.0017, P = 0.002).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,广西与流感相关的 死亡率 过量主要发生在循环系统,集中在老年人中,并且与 A/H3N2 密切相关。这提供了关于亚型特定贡献和高风险群体的新的区域证据,为有针对性的预防策略提供信息。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持优先考虑以 A/H3N2 为重点的 疫苗接种 并加强对广西老年人群的循环系统疾病监测。他们还强调需要整合气象和空气污染数据来完善风险评估。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 生态设计限制了因果推断,并且该研究依赖于汇总数据,而没有对流感感染进行个体层面的临床确认。该模型对于全因 死亡率 的解释力很高,但特定于子类型的估计可能会受到 监测 偏差和未测量的混杂因素的影响,需要谨慎解释。

A/H3N2 showed the strongest association with mortality (IRR = 1.0017, P = 0.002). From 2022 to 2025, influenza-associated excess mortality in a city in Guangxi was characterized by a predominance of circulatory diseases and a concentration of risk among the elderly population, with A/H3N2 being the dominant pathogenic subtype.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 流感给全球健康带来了巨大的负担,包括呼吸系统疾病以外的心血管事件风险增加。然而,中国广西有关流感相关过量 死亡率 的区域数据,特别是亚型特异性贡献和高危人群的数据仍然不足。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项生态时间序列研究收集了广西某市2022年第14周至2025年第13周的每周死亡率数据、A/H3N2、A/H1N1和B/Victoria的流感病毒学监测数据、气象数据和空气污染数据(PM2.5、NO2)。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用具有准泊松分布的广义加性模型 (GAM) 来估计流感相关的过量 死亡率,并根据温度、湿度、PM2.5 和 NO2 进行调整。使用基于 QAIC 的模型比较确定最佳滞后结构,并通过反事实预测将所有流感项设置为零来估计过量的 死亡率。拟合负二项式模型作为敏感性分析。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究强调,广西与流感相关的 死亡率 过量主要发生在循环系统,集中在老年人中,并且与 A/H3N2 密切相关。这提供了关于亚型特定贡献和高风险群体的新的区域证据,为有针对性的预防策略提供信息。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持优先考虑以 A/H3N2 为重点的 疫苗接种 并加强对广西老年人群的循环系统疾病监测。他们还强调需要整合气象和空气污染数据来完善风险评估。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 生态设计限制了因果推断,并且该研究依赖于汇总数据,而没有对流感感染进行个体层面的临床确认。该模型对于全因 死亡率 的解释力很高,但特定于子类型的估计可能会受到 监测 偏差和未测量的混杂因素的影响,需要谨慎解释。

papers.title: Gene expression patterns associated with influenza A and type I hypersensitivity in childhood appendicitis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Both influenza A infection (IAV) and type I hypersensitivity mechanisms have been independently linked to acute appendicitis. Particularly the expression of type I hypersensitivity associated with cytokine interleukin (IL) 13 has been shown to be of significance in both, appendicitis and influenza infection. The aim of the current study was to analyze possible associations of respective gene expressions at the level of mathematical correlations. METHODS: We analyzed messenger RNA (mRNA) gene expressions of IAV-associated markers, hypersensitivity type I-related cytokines and inflammatory markers IL-17A and c-reactive protein (CRP) in peripheral blood mononuclear cells from 29 children aged 7-17 years, who were operated for histologically confirmed appendicitis at Charité-Universitätsmedizin Berlin between April and August 2019. Statistical relationships between gene expressions were investigated using Spearman's correlation analysis, with a correlation coefficient r ≥ 0.5 or r ≤ - 0.5 representing high, and r ≥ 0.7 or r ≤ - 0.7 very high correlations. Statistical significance was assumed at P < 0.01. RESULTS: A total of 29 patients were involved in this study. Particularly the expression of IL-13 showed highly significant negative correlations with that of IAV-specific antiviral response genes, ranging from - 0.89 (P < 0.0001) to - 0.49 (P = 0.006). A strong inflammatory background was demonstrated by very high correlations of IL-13 with CRP (r = 0.91, P < 0.0001) and IL-17A (r = 0.82, P < 0.0001). CONCLUSION: These findings suggest a connection between IAV infection and acute appendicitis in children, implicating sequential immune responses, including hypersensitivity type I mechanisms, in appendicitis pathophysiology.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:甲型流感感染(IAV)和 I 型超敏反应机制均与急性阑尾炎独立相关。特别是与细胞因子白细胞介素 (IL) 13 相关的 I 型超敏反应的表达已被证明在阑尾炎和流感感染中具有重要意义。当前研究的目的是在数学相关性水平上分析各个基因表达的可能关联。方法:我们分析了 29 名 7-17 岁儿童外周血单核细胞中 IAV 相关标志物、超敏反应 I 型相关细胞因子以及炎症标志物 IL-17A 和 C 反应蛋白 (CRP) 的信使 RNA (mRNA) 基因表达,这些儿童于 2019 年 4 月至 8 月在柏林夏里特大学医疗中心因组织学证实的阑尾炎接受手术。采用Spearman相关分析进行研究,相关系数r≥0.5或r≤-0.5代表高度相关,r≥0.7或r≤-0.7代表极高相关。假定 P < 0.01 时具有统计显着性。结果:共有29名患者参与本研究。特别是 IL-13 的表达与 IAV 特异性 抗病毒药物 反应基因的表达呈现高度显着的负相关,范围从 - 0.89 (P < 0.0001) 到 - 0.49 (P = 0.006)。IL-13 与 CRP (r = 0.91,P < 0.0001) 和 IL-17A (r = 0.82,P < 0.0001) 的相关性非常高,证明了强烈的炎症背景。结论:这些发现表明 IAV 感染与儿童急性阑尾炎之间存在联系,暗示阑尾炎病理生理学中的顺序 免疫应答,包括 I 型过敏机制。

papers.title: A tNGS-based comparative study on clinical features and co-detection profiles of hospitalized children with influenza A and B viruses
papers.abstract: Objectives This study aimed to characterize the clinical and epidemiological features of hospitalized children with IBV and compare them with those of influenza A virus (IAV). Methods We enrolled 10,143 pediatric inpatients with ARI between April 2021 and December 2024. Pathogen screening was conducted using targeted next-generation sequencing. Multivariable logistic regression was performed to identify independent predictors for respiratory support requirements. Results IBV was detected in 198 children (2.0%). analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to characterize the clinical and epidemiological features of hospitalized children with influenza B virus (IBV) and compare them with those of influenza A virus (IAV). The scientific and public-health problem lies in understanding the differences in clinical manifestations and co-detection profiles between these two viruses in pediatric populations.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A tNGS-based comparative study was conducted on hospitalized children with acute respiratory infections (ARI) between April 2021 and December 2024. The study enrolled 10,143 pediatric inpatients, comparing clinical features and co-detection profiles of IBV and IAV.
analysis.methods: Pathogen screening was conducted using targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) to identify the presence of influenza A and B viruses. Multivariable logistic regression was performed to analyze independent predictors for respiratory support requirements.
analysis.main_results: IBV was detected in 198 children (2.0%). Children with IBV required less frequent respiratory support than those with IAV (12.6% vs. 18.0%), but multivariable analysis showed that IBV infection independently predicted a higher risk for respiratory support than IAV (aOR = 1.882, 95% CI: 1.134–3.123, p = 0.014).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that IBV and IAV show similar age distributions and comparably high polymicrobial detection rates, but multivariable analysis revealed that IBV infection independently predicted a higher requirement for respiratory support than IAV, indicating a novel finding in the clinical implications of IBV.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform clinical vigilance for respiratory progression in pediatric IBV inpatients and highlight the importance of considering IBV as a significant pathogen in hospitalized children with acute respiratory infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its observational design and potential confounding factors, but the evidence is strong due to the use of targeted next-generation sequencing and multivariable logistic regression analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study aimed to characterize the clinical and epidemiological features of hospitalized children with influenza B virus (IBV) and compare them with those of influenza A virus (IAV). Conducted between April 2021 and December 2024, it enrolled 10,143 pediatric inpatients with acute respiratory infections (ARI) and used targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) for pathogen screening. IBV was detected in 198 children (2.0%), and while initial observations suggested less frequent respiratory support requirements for IBV, multivariable analysis revealed that IBV independently predicted a higher risk for respiratory support than IAV (aOR = 1.882, 95% CI: 1.134–3.123, p = 0.014). The study highlights the need for vigilance in pediatric IBV inpatients and underscores the importance of IBV in clinical settings. However, the observational design and potential confounding factors limit the confidence in the findings, though the evidence is considered strong due to the robust analytical methods used.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述乙型流感病毒(IBV)住院儿童的临床和流行病学特征,并将其与甲型流感病毒(IAV)进行比较。科学和公共卫生问题在于了解这两种病毒在儿科人群中临床表现和共同检测特征的差异。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对 2021 年 4 月至 2024 年 12 月期间住院的急性呼吸道感染 (ARI) 儿童进行了一项基于 tNGS 的比较研究。该研究纳入了 10,143 名儿科住院患者,比较了 IBV 和 IAV 的临床特征和共同检测情况。
elements_zh.methods: 使用靶向下一代测序 (tNGS) 进行病原体筛查,以确定甲型和乙型流感病毒的存在。进行多变量逻辑回归来分析呼吸支持需求的独立预测因素。
elements_zh.main_results: IBV was detected in 198 children (2.0%). Children with IBV required less frequent respiratory support than those with IAV (12.6% vs. 18.0%), but multivariable analysis showed that IBV infection independently predicted a higher risk for respiratory support than IAV (aOR = 1.882, 95% CI: 1.134–3.123, p = 0.014).
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,IBV 和 IAV 显示出相似的年龄分布和相对较高的多种微生物检出率,但多变量分析显示,IBV 感染独立预测比 IAV 更高的呼吸支持需求,这表明 IBV 临床意义的一项新发现。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现可以为临床警惕IBV住院儿科患者的呼吸系统进展提供信息,并强调将IBV视为急性呼吸道感染住院儿童的重要病原体的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到观察设计和潜在混杂因素的限制,但由于使用了靶向下一代测序和多变量逻辑回归分析,证据充足。
